- Swarm B then shipped local-first pseudo-embedding/reranker proof plumbing: default disabled metadata, opt-in deterministic pseudo-embedding and deterministic reranker modes through internal `retrieval_config`, rank transitions, score components, vector ids/hashes, and no raw vectors in receipts.
- Swarm B also produced [`docs/PROVIDER_EMBEDDING_RERANKING_PLAN.md`](docs/PROVIDER_EMBEDDING_RERANKING_PLAN.md), an implementation-ready hosted-provider plan that preserves local/offline defaults, explicit network opt-in, secret redaction, config hashes, benchmark reproducibility, and no raw vector/secret leakage.
- Swarm B then shipped the no-network provider-backed retrieval foundation in [`zerker_memory/retrieval_providers.py`](zerker_memory/retrieval_providers.py): local-only defaults, hosted providers disabled by default, redacted normalized config hashing, env-readiness booleans without secret leakage, and registry lookup.
- Swarm A then added a richer local multi-hop synthetic fixture, `synthetic-multihop-kestrel-locker`, which creates an honest local separation between baseline `fts` and `fts-multihop`.
- Swarm B then exposed provider readiness through `zmem retrieval-providers doctor --summary-only`, a no-network CLI surface that reports local/hosted provider state and env var names without printing secret values.
- The swarm mission/tracker now frames the north star as making ZMem the best AI-agent memory product: frontier-grade on benchmarks and real-world recall quality, with proof/privacy/portability/trust as the wedge.
